comparison: after SSE scan optimization, before vs after WebSocket cancellation and terminal handling
notes: Three sequential paired runs. Same loopback fixture and build flags on both sides.
Downstream HTTP only; does not measure WebSocket throughput, provider inference, or renderer paint.
Mock waits 10 ms before content and 10 ms before completion. Request logging disabled.
CPU and peak RSS include mock and client; RSS is cumulative within each run.
Summary values are medians of per-run metrics, not pooled percentiles.
Release binary, three sequential repetitions of 16 scenarios.
Timer starts immediately before client Close and stops when the mock observes upstream disconnect. Includes test task scheduling.
All scenarios also require a timely Pong and a close acknowledgement without a terminal failure.
No old-version cancellation latency was measured; this is post-change resource release latency only.
Ten paired runs at concurrency 64. Execution order reversed on even runs.
Each side contains 20480 measured requests, with zero errors.
